meta.title: 10 Packing Mistakes That Will RUIN Your Vietnam Trip (2026)
meta.description:
Packing for Vietnam in 2026? Avoid these 10 packing mistakes before traveling to Vietnam. Here is your guide to packing for Vietnam, including important rules, document preparation, and airport and customs mistakes to avoid before you fly.

Most travelers think packing for Vietnam is just about choosing the right clothes until they run into customs rules, cash declaration thresholds, banking lockouts, or documents they should have prepared before leaving home. 

In this video, Attorney Ken Duong breaks down 10 crucial packing and preparation mistakes tourists keep making, and what to do instead. From your passport and power bank to prescription medication, banking, driving documents, and Vietnam Customs, some of the most important Vietnam travel tips are the ones people discover too late. 

And if your Vietnam trip could turn into something longer like working, living in Vietnam, getting married, or opening a business, as some documents may be much easier to prepare before moving to Vietnam.
